music.brief: Low steady pulse under a soft string pad, calm and focused, one gentle lift near the end, instrumental, for a short explainer video, about 60 seconds.

sources: DeLoache et al. (2010). Do babies learn from baby media? Psychological Science.
Robb et al. (2009). Just a talking book? British Journal of Developmental Psychology.
Strouse et al. (2021). Learning from video: A meta-analysis of the video deficit in children ages 0 to 6 years. Child Development.

revised.note: Rewritten as one study told in order (DeLoache et al., 2010), the second trial kept only to answer 'was it a fluke'; the meta-analysis moved to the caption.

beats.text: The babies who learned the most words never saw the video.
beats.say: The babies who learned the most words never saw the video.

beats.text: Here is the study, and the part even the parents got wrong.
beats.say: Here is the study, and the part even the parents got wrong.

beats.text: 12 to 18 months. A popular word video at home for a month.
beats.say: Families of twelve to eighteen month olds played a popular word video at home for a month.

beats.text: They learned no more of its words than babies who never saw it.
beats.say: Those babies learned no more of its words than babies who never saw it.

beats.text: The most learning: parents teaching the same words in everyday routines.
beats.say: The most learning was in a group with no video, where parents taught the same words in everyday routines.

beats.text: And parents who liked the video thought their baby had learned more.
beats.sub: More than the babies actually had.
beats.say: And the parents who liked the video tended to think their baby had learned more than they had.

beats.text: A fluke? A second trial, 12 to 15 months, found the same.
beats.say: Was it a fluke? A second trial, with twelve to fifteen month olds, found the same.

beats.text: The honest catch: these trials tested word videos and word learning.
beats.sub: Not every screen in your home.
beats.say: The honest catch is that these trials tested word videos, not every screen in your home.

beats.text: So do what that group did. Name the cup in the bath.
beats.sub: The spoon at dinner. The sock while dressing. Then wait.
beats.say: So do what that group did. Name the cup in the bath, the spoon at dinner, the sock while dressing, then wait.
